paragraphs: Mentioned in Beitzah 25b: our Rabbis relied on his statement, “I carried Rav Huna from Hini to Shili,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The full Beitzah 25b wording makes Rav Huna the person carried from Hini to Shili; the source’s etc is retained without supplying the rest of the story.

The whole Davidson Beitzah 25b paragraph explicitly has Achi Shakya carrying Rav Huna from Hini to Shili and back. It supports the contextual ר״ה expansion and direction in the retained note. Only Hyman’s supplied first direction and etc. are translated; the return journey and other speakers are not imported.
